sloka: सुन्दे तु निहते राम सा अगस्त्यम् ऋषि सत्तमम् ।ताटका सह पुत्रेण प्रधर्षयितुम् इच्छति ॥१-२५-१०॥
transliteration: sunde tu nihate rāma sā agastyam ṛṣi sattamam ।tāṭakā saha putreṇa pradharṣayitum icchati ॥1-25-10॥

translations.english: Roaring, she rushed with excitement to devour him. The venerable rishi Agastya saw her approaching him and cursed Maricha to assume form of a demoness.
